messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 2):
"""
This is an indicative list. Insurer must ensure that all the benefits of the policy are listed above) 6 Exclusions (what the policy does not cover) (Note: Insurer has to ensure that all the applicable exclusions are listed here) 7 Waiting period  Time period during which specified diseases/treatments are not covered  It is counted from the beginning of the policy coverage. Initial waiting Period: xx days for all illnesses (not applicable in case of continuous renewal or accidents) Specific Waiting periods (Not applicable for claims arising due to an accident): o xx months for xx diseases/procedures o yy months for yy diseases/procedures Pre-existing diseases: Covered after xx months 8 Financial limits of coverage i. Sub-limit (It is a predefined limit and the insurance company will not pay any amount in excess of this limit) ii.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the initial waiting period for all illnesses under the policy, and does it apply to accident claims?","answer":"The initial waiting period is xx days for all illnesses, and it does not apply to accident claims.","facts":["Initial waiting Period: xx days for all illnesses (not applicable in case of continuous renewal or accidents)"]},{"question":"After how many months are pre‑existing diseases covered under the policy?","answer":"Pre‑existing diseases are covered after xx months.","facts":["Pre-existing diseases: Covered after xx months"]}]}
